semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ceramic cleavers, which are essential materials in semiconductor chip bonding processes.
summary: Suzhou Xinhe Semiconductor Materials Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development and manufacturing of ceramic cleavers, a critical component in semiconductor chip packaging and bonding. As China's first domestically produced ceramic cleaver manufacturer targeting the mid-to-high-end market, the company aims to lead in high-precision materials and expand into overseas markets.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and is actively expanding its operations within the domestic market and into overseas markets.
